title: Flipping Container
statement: A cuboid container with three distinct side lengths, at most 1000 each, can only be moved by tipping it 90 degrees over one of its four bottom edges. Determine the minimum number of such flips that carry it by a given east-west and north-south displacement, each up to 10^18 in magnitude, so that it ends with exactly its starting orientation, or report that the target is unreachable.
